scope: Own active context and booking capability revalidated in the same transaction/connection.
Anonymous union of clipped GiST-blocking intervals, including cleanup, BLOCK and holds until real state transition.
No reservation, actor or other unit identifiers; 31-day/microsecond bounds and 503 rather than partial occupancy above 1000 rows.
Client validates context/range/time zone and microseconds, isolates query keys, cancels on context change, expires after 30 seconds and refreshes GET after conflict without replaying POST.
No migrations, grants or RLS changes.
limitations: Browser journeys use synthetic API fixtures in the CI runner; isolated HTTPS BFF integration additionally exercises real Java/PostgreSQL with synthetic local Auth.
No real Supabase Auth journey, runtime/Vercel credential provisioning, onboarding, capacity or full PRD acceptance is established.
BFF and reservations remain disabled in the published environment pending the operational gates.
